title: Trenches To Benches
joke: One soldier stuck in a trench is confused while the other cheerfully builds benches, because if you can't leave yet you can at least sit down and keep going.
caption:
Look at the guy on the left. He's all of us in a rough month.
When you can't climb out of a hard season fast, small comforts help you keep moving forward.
What's your bench when money feels heavy?
alt: Two helmeted stick-figure soldiers stand in a trench under a quote sign while one happily hammers together wooden benches.
